routines.semantics: SpiceDouble pi_c(void), raw.pi(): number. Returns pi radians, computed by CSPICE as acos(-1). No inputs, capacities, indexing, kernel requirement, handles, ownership transfer or observable mutable state.

scenarios.observes: Actual raw.pi return is propagated as StepOutput.value and compared with direct locked SpiceyPy pi execution; full double scalar is retained without normalization.
Actual raw.pi return is propagated as StepOutput.value and compared with direct locked SpiceyPy pi execution; repeat around kclear/reset observes unchanged value without kernels.

routines.edgeAssessment: Zero-argument constant has no input boundaries or legitimate absence; repeated calls and clearing state are covered. The focused constant test supplements registered parity with exact live-oracle equality, unit relationships and Julian-day magnitude/fraction assertions.
routines.errorAssessment: NAIF and pinned N0067 source document an error-free routine. No fabricated input/error test. Direct shared-C return does not allocate or inspect/reset CSPICE error state. Node adapter separately rejects malformed native results.
routines.fixtureRationale: No kernels, files, scientific datasets or authored fixtures needed; all values are returned live by CSPICE through both independent bindings.
routines.cleanup: No output buffers or handles allocated by the scalar shim/WASM path; Node serializes CSPICE access under the existing mutex. Case/backend finalizers retain standard clear/reset/dispose behavior.
routines.tolerance: Registered parity keeps the unchanged 1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparator. Focused constants.test.ts additionally compares actual scalar results exactly with live SpiceyPy, preventing tolerance at Julian-date magnitude from concealing a lost B1950 fractional day. No global tolerance changes.
